== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Blizzard 1 (PC Errata 2017 slip)]]. Compared with [[Blizzard 1 (PC Errata 2016 disc card)]] (by 19 November 2016). The same area of the disc image, scaled to the slip's width, and the 2017 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).
